svg.title: Component-first (Option B): the chain from the rule to the claim and the result
svg.desc: A chain of 6 steps, each drawn as one row per relationship, with the field that holds the pointer on the left and the field it resolves to on the right. Step 1, rule to check, is made of 2 relationships. checks[].rule-id in the component-definition, which holds ubtu24_data_at_rest_encrypted, composite key to components[].rules[].id in the component-definition. checks[].target-component-uuid in the component-definition, which holds 5ca997b3-bb3e-4c7a-8969-69ed44577d47, composite key to components[].uuid in the component-definition. Step 2, rule to control, is made of 2 relationships. implemented-requirements[].implementing-rules[].rule-id in the component-definition, which holds ubtu24_data_at_rest_encrypted, reference to components[].rules[].id in the component-definition. implemented-requirements[].control-id in the component-definition, which holds sc-28, reference to controls[].id in the catalog. Step 3, check to runtime, is made of 1 relationship. no field in the component-definition containment to components[].uuid in the component-definition. Step 4, runtime to claim, is made of 2 relationships. by-components[].implementing-rules[].rule-id in the system-security-plan, which holds ubtu24_data_at_rest_encrypted, reference to components[].rules[].id in the component-definition. by-components[].component-uuid in the system-security-plan, which holds 534b356b-0de1-48d4-8536-5d41ed717456, reference to system-implementation.components[].uuid in the system-security-plan. Step 5, runtime to result, is made of 2 relationships. observations[].assessment-check-id in the assessment-results, which holds SV-270747r1066730_rule, reference to checks[].id in the component-definition. observations[].subjects[].subject-uuid in the assessment-results, which holds 06297a03-cae0-414b-8332-2fc882f81aa1, reference to system-implementation.inventory-items[].uuid in the system-security-plan. Step 6, result to control, is made of 1 relationship. no field in the assessment-results no join to no field in the catalog. Every value is rule 1, data at rest, as the six questions page encodes it for this approach.
